views.markdown:
- First formal release based on the tested dev.40 implementation.

- Reverted the Dynamic Island auto-hide behavior; restored the previous always-visible status-bar display.

- Fixed the packaged preference plist so the new upload/download and font settings appear on-device.

- Simplified preferences to separate upload/download visibility, latency/IP, font size, bold text, and refresh interval.

- Removed one-time hierarchy diagnostics, verbose render logs, and the broad UIView tint hook after confirming direct status-bar foreground mounting.

- Avoid treating empty full-screen status-bar layout placeholders as the icon host and log all SpringBoard windows for discovery.

- Added one-time status-bar hierarchy diagnostics to identify the real cellular/Wi-Fi icon host for exact sibling mounting.

- Ignore the foreground container's accent-blue tint and prioritize actual icon color or status-bar style.

- Keep the label in the scene overlay when the discovered status-bar object is a clipping layout container, while still using it for color discovery.

- Fixed status-bar-container coordinates so the label is not placed outside the discovered view after direct mounting.

- Discover the status-bar container from active SpringBoard windows when private layout hooks are unavailable.

- Re-scan leaf status-bar icon views and react to runtime `setTintColor:` changes.

- Read the resolved tint from status-bar icon descendants before using the foreground container color.

- Prefer mounting the label inside `_UIStatusBarForegroundView` so it inherits the real status-bar tint color, with the scene overlay retained as a fallback.
